subject.title: feat(models): make per-agent model allowlist explicit; aliases/defaults no longer restrict

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `agents.*.modelPolicy.allow` as the permanent public authorization contract and preserve legacy default-map restrictions through the proposed marker-gated migration?
rationale: This introduces a persistent public configuration and migration contract whose compatibility and authorization semantics require owner acceptance beyond a routine code review.

options.title: Adopt explicit policy contract
options.body: Approve the new explicit policy direction after final-head upgrade proof confirms legacy restrictions remain fail-closed until migrated.

options.title: Retain legacy map contract
options.body: Keep `agents.defaults.models` as the authorization surface and narrow this work to diagnostics or documentation improvements.

options.title: Split the migration proposal
options.body: Merge only a bounded compatibility-safe precursor after defining the permanent configuration contract separately.
